readme:
# OpenCode Supreme Setup > **From zero to 480+ skills, 11 sub-agents, Team Mode, and Caveman efficiency — in one command.** ## Quick Install ```powershell # Windows (PowerShell 7+) irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/skeletorflet/opencode-supreme-setup/master/install.ps1 | iex ``` ```bash # Linux / macOS curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/skeletorflet/opencode-supreme-setup/master/install.sh | bash ``` ```bash # Or clone git clone https://github.com/skeletorflet/opencode-supreme-setup.git && cd opencode-supreme-setup # Windows: .\install.ps1 | Linux/macOS: chmod +x install.sh && ./install.sh ``` ![OpenCode Supreme Setup Banner](https://github.com/skeletorflet/opencode-supreme-setup/blob/master/banner.webp?raw=true) --- ## What You Get | Category | Included | |----------|----------| | **Agent Orchestration** | oh-my-openagent — Sisyphus loops, Team Mode (8 parallel), 11 sub-agents | | **Team Mode** | 8 max parallel members, team task system, team messaging | | **Caveman Mode** | Ultra-efficient AGENTS.md — zero fluff, surgical AST/LSP edits, English-only output | | **Custom Agents** | `caveman`, `spec-architect`, `self-healer`, `security-auditor`, `docs-writer`, `refactor`, `speckit` | | **Sub-Agents** | `sisyphus`, `oracle`, `librarian`, `explore`, `multimodal-looker`, `prometheus`, `metis`, `momus`, `atlas`, `sisyphus-junior`, `hephaestus` | | **Agent Categories** | visual-engineering, ultrabrain, deep, artistry, quick, unspecified-low, unspecified-high, writing | | **Skills** | 480+ across 3 sources (marketplace CKMs + agent skills + project presets) | | **Plugins** | 13 plugins — snippets, snip, notify, mem, quota, background-agents, worktree, context-pruning, smart-title, ocwatch, superpowers, supermemory, oh-my-openagent | | **MCP Servers** | web-search (Tavily), pdf-reader, google-drive, memory-plus, codegraph | | **Memory** | opencode-mem (vector-DB, web UI localhost:4747) + supermemory (cross-session knowledge) | | **Token Savings** | `snip` CLI — filters shell output, 60-90% fewer tokens | | **Model** | 100% `opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash` across all agents + fallbacks | | **Optimizations** | Hashline edits, runtime fallback (auto-retry 400/429/503/529), dynamic context pruning (dedup, supersede writes, purge errors), auto-resume, aggressive truncation, streaming tools | ## Prerequisites - **Node.js** 18+ • **Bun** 1.x (auto-installed) • **PowerShell 7+** or **bash 4+** ## Default Model Configuration All agents are pre-configured with **`opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash`** — a cost-efficient model that consumes very few tokens per session, making it ideal for the agent-heavy workflows in this setup. > To change the model or provider, edit `%userprofile%\.config\opencode\oh-my-openagent.json` and update the `model` field for any agent or category. ## What Gets Installed The installer runs 10 automated steps (Turbo Installer v3): | Step | What | |------|------| | 1 | Prerequisites (Node.js, PowerShell 7+ / Bash 4+) | | 2 | Mass NPM Ecosystem — 15 packages in one batch (opencode-ai, bun, openskills, 12 plugins, dev tools) | | 3 | Spec-kit CLI — Spec-Driven Development toolkit (via uv or npm) | | 4 | oh-my-openagent — agent orchestration, sub-agents, Team Mode, MCPs | | 5 | GitHub CLI (via winget/brew/apt) | | 6 | OpenSkills repositories — anthropics/skills, mattpocock/skills, caveman, graphify, open-design | | 7 | YAML Patch — fixes open-design-landing SKILL.md syntax | | 8 | Config Sync — copies opencode.json, oh-my-openagent.json, AGENTS.md, codegraph skill | | 9 | SpecKit Agent injection — adds unified speckit agent to opencode.json | | 10 | CodeGraph init & oh-my-openagent doctor health check | Agent ecosystem is finalized in `opencode.json` with 7 custom agents registered (caveman, speckit, self-healer, security-auditor, refactor, docs-writer, spec-architect) and oh-my-openagent provides 11 sub-agents (sisyphus, oracle, librarian, explore, multimodal-looker, prometheus, metis, momus, atlas, sisyphus-junior, hephaestus). ## Skills ### 480+ Unique Skills Skills are aggregated from 3 sources: | Source | Count | Notes | |--------|-------|-------| | `~/.config/opencode/skills/` | ~137 | Built-in opencode skills + synced reference presets | | `~/.agents/skills/` | 9 | build-your-own-x, compress, find-skills, skill-sync | | `.claude/skills/` (project) | 335 | Marketplace CKMs, community plugins, creative tools, templates | The ecosystem badge displays 480+ accounting for all marketplace skills from Anthropic's ecosystem, community contributions, and project presets combined. **Categories include:** | Category | Skills | |----------|--------| | **Frontend** | angular, astro, gatsby, gsap, htmx, motion-framer, nextjs, nuxt, svelte, tailwind, threejs, vue | | **Backend** | actix-web, aspnet-core, bun, django, elysia, express, fastapi, fastify, fiber, flask, gin, hono, koa, laravel, nestjs, rails | | **Languages** | dart, deno, elixir, go-lang, kotlin, rust, solidjs, swift, zig | | **Mobile/Desktop** | electron, flutter, react-native, tauri | | **Databases** | drizzle, mongodb, postgresql, prisma, redis, sqlite, supabase | | **AI/ML** | crewai, huggingface, langchain, ollama, pytorch, tensorflow | | **DevOps** | ansible, github-actions, helm, kubernetes, pulumi, terraform | | **Design** | d3js, material-ui, shadcn, ui-styling, ui-ux-pro-max, banner-design, brand, design | | **Creative** | hyperframes, algorithmic-art, canvas-design, sprite-animation, shader-dev, hand-drawn-diagrams | | **HTML Decks (50+)** | html-ppt, kami-deck, deck-swiss-international, guizang-ppt, 40+ Zhangzara templates | | **Media** | fal-generate, fal-3d, fal-video-edit, imagem, sora, replicate, venice-* | | **Methodology** | brainstorming, TDD, diagnose, systematic-debugging, review, verification-before-completion | | **Workflow** | superpowers (dispatching-parallel-agents, executing-plans, writing-plans, subagent-driven-development, finishing-a-development-branch) | Use: `skill(name="")` to load any skill. ### MCP Servers | Server | Purpose | |--------|---------| | **web-search** (Tavily) | Real-time web search via MCP | | **pdf-reader** | Read and analyze PDF documents | | **google-drive** | Access files in Google Drive | | **memory-plus** | Advanced graph-based memory | | **codegraph** | Pre-indexed code knowledge graph — 92% fewer tool calls for code exploration | ## Agents ### Primary Agents | Agent | Description | |-------|-------------| | `caveman` | **Default** — Ultra-efficient coder, zero fluff, max output | | `@spec-architect` | Spec-Driven Development — creates SPEC.md from requirements | | `@speckit` | Full SpecKit SDD from zero to working build (7 steps via 7-step manual workflow: constitution → specify → clarify → plan → validate → tasks → implement) | | `@self-healer` | Autonomous debugging — fixes build/test failures silently | | `@security-auditor` | Security audit — finds vulns, secrets, injection risks | | `@refactor` | Code refactoring specialist — reduces duplication, modernizes | | `@docs-writer` | Documentation writer — clear, concise markdown docs | ### Sub-Agents (oh-my-openagent) | Agent | Category | Purpose | |-------|----------|---------| | `sisyphus` | — | Main orchestrator, persistent loops, boulder tracking | | `hephaestus` | — | Build & forge agent — construction, assembly, heavy lifting | | `oracle` | ultrabrain | Deep analysis, architecture, research | | `librarian` | quick | External reference grep — docs, OSS examples | | `explore` | quick | Codebase exploration and pattern discovery | | `multimodal-looker` | visual-engineering | Image/visual analysis | | `prometheus` | deep | Strategic planning, Prometheus plan agent | | `metis` | deep | Technical design, problem-solving, pre-planning | | `momus` | writing | Critique, review, plan evaluation | | `atlas` | unspecified-high | Heavy implementation work | | `sisyphus-junior` | unspecified-low | Lightweight task execution, category-routed | ### Agent Categories | Category | Domain | Use Case | |----------|--------|----------| | `visual-engineering` | Frontend, UI/UX, design, styling, animation | All visual/UI work | | `ultrabrain` | Hard logic, architecture, algorithms | Complex reasoning | | `deep` | Goal-oriented autonomous research + implementation | End-to-end feature work | | `artistry` | Creative, unconventional problem-solving | Beyond standard patterns | | `quick` | Trivial tasks, single-file edits, typos | Simple fixes | | `unspecified-low` | General low-effort work | Non-domain-specific small tasks | | `unspecified-high` | General high-effort work | Non-domain-specific complex tasks | | `writing` | Documentation, prose, technical writing | Docs and content | ## Plugins (13) | Plugin | Role | |--------|------| | `oh-my-openagent` | Agent orchestration, Team Mode, sub-agents, MCPs, fallback | | `opencode-snippets` | `#snippet` inline text expansion | | `opencode-snip` | Auto `snip` prefix for 60-90% token reduction on shell output | | `opencode-notify` | Native OS notifications on task completion | | `opencode-mem` | Persistent vector-DB memory with web UI (localhost:4747) | | `opencode-quota` | Token usage and cost tracking | | `opencode-background-agents` | Async delegation (8 concurrent, 5 model-specific) | | `opencode-worktree` | Zero-friction isolated git worktrees | | `opencode-dynamic-context-pruning` | Auto-prune obsolete tool outputs after N turns | | `opencode-smart-title` | Auto-generated meaningful session titles | | `ocwatch` | Real-time agent activity dashboard | | `superpowers` | Workflow engine — brainstorming, TDD, subagent-dev, debugging | | `supermemory` | Cross-session persistent knowledge | ## Skills Ecosystem - **480+ unique skills** across 3 source trees: - `~/.config/opencode/skills/` (~137) — Built-in opencode skills + synced reference presets - `~/.agents/skills/` (9) — build-your-own-x, compress, find-skills, skill-sync - Project `.claude/skills/` (335) — Marketplace CKMs, community plugins, creative tools, HTML decks - **Categories**: Frontend, Backend, Languages, Mobile/Desktop, Databases, AI/ML, DevOps, Design, Creative, HTML Decks (50+), Media, Methodology, Workflow - **MCP Servers**: web-search (Tavily), pdf-reader, google-drive, memory-plus, codegraph ## Team Mode Team Mode is **enabled** with: - **8 max parallel members** - Task system with dependency tracking (`blockedBy`) - Team messaging and broadcasting - Shutdown approval workflow - Supports categories: deep, ultrabrain, quick, visual-engineering, artistry, writing, unspecified-low, unspecified-high Use `team_create`, `team_send_message`, `team_task_*` tools. ## Usage ``` opencode # Launch (caveman mode default) @spec-architect # Create SPEC.md (SDD) @speckit # Full SpecKit SDD from zero to working build (7 steps) @self-healer # Auto-fix build/test failures @security-auditor # Security audit @refactor # Refactor code @docs-writer # Generate documentation skill(name="") # Load any skill ulw # Ultrawork mode (parallel agents) #snippet # Text expansion npx openskills read # Load marketplace skill ``` ## OpenCode Tool Mapping Skills referencing Claude Code tools must use OpenCode equivalents: | Skill Reference | OpenCode Tool | |-----------------|---------------| | `TodoWrite` | `task_create` | | `TodoWrite` mark complete | `task_update(status="completed")` | | `TodoWrite` mark in_progress | `task_update(status="in_progress")` | | List `TodoWrite` | `task_list()` | | Get `TodoWrite` | `task_get(id)` | NEVER call `todoWrite` — it will fail. Use the `task_*` tools above. ## Files | File | Purpose | |------|---------| | `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json` | Main config — plugins, agents, model, skills path | | `~/.config/opencode/oh-my-openagent.json` | Plugin config — sub-agents, team mode, MCP servers, fallback, pruning | | `~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md` | Global caveman instructions + skill references | | `config/opencode.json` | Reference template (project copy) | | `config/oh-my-openagent.json` | Reference template (project copy) | | `config/AGENTS.md` | Reference template (project copy) | | `config/skills/` | 138 reference skill definitions synced to user config | | `config/skills.txt` | Index of all config skill names | | `install.ps1` | Windows installer (PowerShell 7+) | | `install.sh` | Linux/macOS installer | | `uninstall.ps1` | Windows uninstaller | | `uninstall.sh` | Linux/macOS uninstaller | | `.claude/skills/` | 335 project-level skill definitions | | `scripts/` | CI/CD, validation, and bundle scripts | | `CONTRIBUTING.md` | Guide for adding skills, plugins, themes | | `.github/workflows/ci.yml` | CI — validates config, skills, installers | ## Troubleshooting | Problem | Solution | |---------|----------| | `ConfigInvalidError` | Delete `~/.config/opencode/opencode.jsonc` (old format) | | Plugin not loading | `/plugin remove ` then `/plugin add ` | | Skills not triggering | Ensure `~/.config/opencode/skills//SKILL.md` exists | | snip not reducing tokens | `snip --version`, reinstall with `go install github.com/edouard-claude/snip/cmd/snip@latest` | | opencode-mem not working | Check web UI at `http://localhost:4747` | | Team Mode not working | Verify `team_mode.enabled: true` in oh-my-openagent.json | ## Post-Install ```powershell opencode auth login # Authenticate with your AI provider ``` ## Contributing See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
